Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent version healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
- **Rollback**: Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error; a retry completed the rollout to all regions. Verified: checkout-api is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback action. (The initial incident request timed out, but I confirmed it was created and did not duplicate it.)

On-call has been paged and should investigate the v2.3.1 regression.
